Name: Boss Battle
Author: Akatsuki718
Description:
Boss Battle

This beta includes three boss encounters, with more to come. Use the elevator at the mine entrance to choose an arena, then walk north to begin.

Slime King — Defeat the Slime King to earn the Slime Scepter. The included guide explains how to summon two knights to help with combat or gathering.
Bat Lord — Earn the Echo Necklace. Equip it in the hat slot and use sonar to find resources, mine ladders, and buried caches.
Void Squad — Face the Void Brute, Void Marksman, and Void Shaman together. When one falls, the survivors enter their next phase. Defeat the squad to earn the Void Core. Hold and use it to unlock Void Travel, Void Ward, and Void Shockwave.

Requires Stardew Valley 1.6.15, SMAPI 4.1.10 or later, and Content Patcher 2.9.0 or later. Generic Mod Config Menu is optional.

Extract the Boss Battle folder into Mods with both Runtime and Content inside. When updating, move the old Boss Battle folder outside Mods before extracting the new version.

Supports English and Simplified Chinese. Custom artwork was created with AI assistance. Feedback and bug reports are welcome!


Boss Battle（简体中文）

目前为测试版，包含三场 Boss 战，后续会陆续加入更多 Boss。在矿井入口使用电梯选择场地，进入后向北走即可开始挑战。

史莱姆王 — 首次击败可获得史莱姆权杖。随包指南介绍了如何召唤两名骑士，协助战斗或采集资源。
蝙蝠领主 — 首次击败可获得回音项链。将项链装备在帽子栏，即可使用声呐寻找资源、矿井梯子和埋藏的宝箱。
虚空小队 — 同时迎战虚空狂徒、虚空狙击手和虚空萨满。每击败一名成员，其余成员就会进入下一阶段。首次击败小队可获得虚空核心，手持并使用即可解锁虚空穿梭、虚空护体和虚空震荡。

运行需要《星露谷物语》1.6.15、SMAPI 4.1.10 或以上版本，以及 Content Patcher 2.9.0 或以上版本。Generic Mod Config Menu（通用模组配置菜单）为可选前置。

将 Boss Battle 文件夹解压到 Mods 中，保留其中的 Runtime 和 Content 两个文件夹。更新时先将旧版 Boss Battle 文件夹移出 Mods，再解压新版。

支持简体中文和英文。自定义美术素材采用 AI 辅助制作。欢迎反馈游玩体验或遇到的问题！
